Boek 1 - Grondslagen, vraag en aanbod/shared/task-shell-ui.js as the deployed shared-shell dependency required for step_ordering playability

node scripts/deploy.js "../4veco-lessen/Boek 1 - Grondslagen, vraag en aanbod"
npm.cmd run check:book -- "../4veco-lessen/Boek 1 - Grondslagen, vraag en aanbod"
forbidden: No hand edits to generated Book 1 output.
No candidate storage creation or writes.
No target-equivalent claims or completion language.
No engines/reasoning-engine.js, engines/task-shell-engine.js, or engines/task-shell-ui.js edits without plan revision.
No generated lesson diffs outside the generated_output_map without stopping for review.
No diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery, sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV, Scale Gate 1, or product-wide use.
stop_conditions: Planning review returns REVISE and the plan/plan JSON have not been corrected and rechecked.
Generated reasoning pages do not load TaskShellUI and TaskShellEngine.
Modes 0, 1, or 3 fall back to private-only UI instead of the shared step_ordering task shell.
Local task-shell feedback is missing after checking a mode 0/1/3 answer.
Duplicate feedback regions stack after repeated attempts or navigation.
Mode 2 or mode 4 is described as adopted into the shared shell.
Deploy produces diffs outside the generated_output_map.
Any artifact claims target-equivalent proof, diagnostics, mastery, sequencing, Scale Gate 1, or product use.
